page.overview:
Who is Raja?

Raja is a character from Street Fighter II V who appears in episodes 8 and 10.

Raja takes his job seriously and determine to save young people who are addicted to drugs. He also has faith in his officers such as Soong, but becomes shocked when he discovers that he is a spy from Ashura.

He is head of security of the Bangkok airport. Category:Characters Category:Street Fighter II V Characters Category:Male Characters Category:Non Video Game Characters
